result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't write new tests or check the fixed patterns against sample files. The module's `*Scoping*` tests pass.

- **Gradle JS:** in `addBuildAndDeploymentConventions`, the pattern `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.
- **`.xml` and `.js` generated rules:** in `addGeneratedConventions`, `.*/[.]xml` (the `<doc>` rule) and `.*/[.]js` (the `// Generated by` rule) are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so they match real file names instead of only a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`.
- **pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator pages:** the file pattern `(html|html|xhtml)` repeated `html` where `htm` was meant. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)` in all three rules.

The content patterns and line limits are unchanged. Doxygen `.html` pages, `.xhtml` pages with a generator meta tag and `build.gradle` still match.
